facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary and secondary endpoints; market withdrawal possible · Phase 3 · AMX0035 in ALS · on market

evidence.summary: PHOENIX did not meet its primary endpoint of reaching statistical significance (p=0.667) as measured by change from baseline in the Revised Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Functional Rating Scale
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: PHOENIX did not meet its primary endpoint of reaching statistical significance (p=0.667)
evidence.safety: AMX0035 was well-tolerated in PHOENIX. There were no new safety signals, reinforcing the favorable and manageable safety profile observed with AMX0035 to date.
